title: BPW-2026-0535
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0535
The Mayor and City Council have approved and authorized the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Engineering and Bureau of Contract Administration, to execute the sole source contract with Data Trace Information Services LLC.
(REF: BPW-2025-0514)
summary: Authorization for the Board of Public Works to sign a sole source contract with Data Trace Information Services LLC for the Bureau of Engineering and Bureau of Contract Administration.
